claims.claim: The script reads the export's segments list and draws a segment when its kind is lyric or backing (a missing kind counts as lyric) and its words list is not empty.

claims.claim: It reads each drawn segment's startTime and endTime and each word's word, startTime and endTime, in seconds; segments of any other kind are skipped.

claims.claim: If no lyric or backing segment has words, the script stops with 'No timed words found. Export the JSON from Syynk with word timing included.'

observations.text: In our test, with Blender 5.2's factory settings, the view transform was AgX, and a requested gold (#F2C14E) rendered as a muted tan.
observations.basis: Render on 2026-09-28: sampled (199,169,111) under AgX vs (247,197,81) under Standard.

observations.text: In our test, EEVEE took about 2 seconds a frame on an RTX 2070 Max-Q laptop GPU. The three-hours-for-three-minutes figure is an extrapolation, stated in SKILL.md as an estimate.
observations.basis: 916-frame render, 33 minutes including ~2 minutes of setup, 2026-09-28.

verificationPass.method: Three adversarial rounds. Each claim was given, with its cited source, to a separate verifier agent that had no access to the drafting rationale and was told to refute it and to count uncertainty as refuted. Web sources were fetched with curl and read as text; the bundled script was read line by line; c1 was checked by byte comparison with the live download. Round 1 (all 18 claims): 7 confirmed, 11 refuted. Round 2 (the 12 revised or new claims): 9 confirmed, 3 refuted. Round 3 (the 6 rewritten or new claims plus 4 flagged sentences): 5 confirmed, 1 refuted, 2 sentences tightened. Every refutation was fixed by narrowing the claim to what the source says, correcting a locator, or cutting; the final wording of each claim is the one that survived.
verificationPass.runBy: Claude (Claude Code session): opus-tier verifier agents, separate from the drafting agent
verificationPass.caveat: The verifiers were separate agent instances from the drafter, but the same underlying model, so their independence is procedural, not organisational. The round-3 fixes to c25 and c26 (and the two sentences) were applied from the verifier's own suggested wording and were not re-verified in a fourth round. Human reviewer sign-off is recorded in the pull request.
